title: Virtual Double Oracle: Faster Convergence by Leveraging Strategies That Were Watching All Along
abstract: arXiv:2611.22806v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Double Oracle (DO) and PSRO approximate Nash equilibria in two-player zero-sum games by iteratively expanding a strategy population with best responses supplied by an oracle. Online Double Oracle (ODO) interleaves multiplicative weights updates (MWU) with population discovery and obtains an $O(\sqrt{k\ln k/T})$ rate, where $T$ is the number of learning rounds and $k$ is the larger of the two players' final population sizes. We identify the reinitialisation step as an underexplored design choice: at each expansion, MWU-based methods reset newly discovered strategies to a uniform prior. We introduce Virtual Double Oracle (VDO), which exploits a bilinear identity (a strategy's full hindsight loss history collapses to its utility against the time-averaged opponent) to initialise each new strategy with the MWU weight it would have had from the start. translated_title: 虚拟双重神谕：利用一直“旁观全程”的策略实现更快收敛
translated_abstract: 双重神谕与 PSRO 通过由神谕提供的最佳响应迭代扩展策略种群，来近似双人零和博弈中的纳什均衡。在线双重神谕将乘性权重更新（MWU）与种群发现交织进行，获得了 O(√(k ln k / T)) 的收敛速率，其中 T 为学习轮数，k 为两个玩家最终种群规模的较大者。我们发现重新初始化步骤是一个尚未被充分探索的设计选择：在每次种群扩展时，基于 MWU 的方法会将新发现的策略重置为均匀先验。我们提出虚拟双重神谕（VDO），它利用一个双线性恒等式（策略完整的“事后”损失历史可坍缩为其相对于时间平均对手的效用），为每个新策略赋予其从一开始就应累积的 MWU 权重作为初始值。我们证明，VDO 在所发现的种群上取得了 O(√(k/T)) 的可利用性，就好像……
tldr: 提出虚拟双重神谕（VDO），利用双线性恒等式让新发现的策略以“仿佛从一开始就参与学习”的权重初始化，将可利用性收敛速率从 O(√(k ln k / T)) 改进到 O(√(k/T))。
en_tdlr: Virtual Double Oracle (VDO) initializes newly discovered strategies with the MWU weights they would have accumulated from the start via a bilinear identity, improving the exploitability rate from O(√(k ln k / T)) to O(√(k/T)).
